bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state lands; authorizing the sale of tax-forfeited lands in Itasca County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+PRIVATE SALE OF TAX-FORFEITED LAND BORDERING PUBLIC WATERS; ITASCA COUNTY. +]

[+Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, sections 92.45; 282.018, subdivision 1; or the public sale provisions of Minnesota Statutes, chapter 282, Itasca County may sell by private sale up to ten percent of the tax-forfeited land bordering public water that is located in the county as of the effective date of this section under the remaining provisions of Minnesota Statutes, chapter 282. The conveyance must be in a form approved by the attorney general. This authority is in addition to any other authority conferred on the county to sell tax-forfeited lands. The county has determined that the county's land management interests would best be served if the land was returned to private ownership. This section expires June 30, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state lands; authorizing the sale of tax-forfeited lands in Itasca County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. PRIVATE SALE OF TAX-FORFEITED LAND BORDERING PUBLIC WATERS; ITASCA COUNTY.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, sections 92.45; 282.018, subdivision 1; or the public sale provisions of Minnesota Statutes, chapter 282, Itasca County may sell by private sale up to ten percent of the tax-forfeited land bordering public water that is located in the county as of the effective date of this section under the remaining provisions of Minnesota Statutes, chapter 282. The conveyance must be in a form approved by the attorney general. This authority is in addition to any other authority conferred on the county to sell tax-forfeited lands. The county has determined that the county's land management interests would best be served if the land was returned to private ownership. This section expires June 30, 2027.
